nodes.title: Note: Model Storage & Custom Nodes
widgets_values:
# Model Storage Location

```text
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    ├── diffusion_models/
    │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
    ├── text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
    ├── vae/
    │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
    │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
    ├── checkpoints/
    │   └── sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors
    └── loras/
        ├── minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
        └── h3_character_swap_v1.5.safetensors
```

Select these files in the matching loaders. An existing shared model directory also works when ComfyUI is configured to use it.

**V1.5 filename:** the saved LoRA loader uses `h3-v2-challenge-eval-20261013/v2-1000.safetensors`, the validation alias for V1.5. Select your downloaded `h3_character_swap_v1.5.safetensors` in that loader, or keep the same subfolder/alias. Both names refer to the same weights.

## Custom nodes

Install [H3 Relay](https://github.com/akatz-ai/h3-relay) under `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/h3-relay/`. This canvas requires the **Relay 2.0 toolkit**. Use a current ComfyUI with native H3, SAM3 and Start Loop / End Loop support; restart after installing nodes. FFmpeg and FFprobe must be on PATH.

Blue nodes are H3 Relay helpers; the surrounding groups show where they fit. Green nodes are user inputs. Red nodes save output.

nodes.title: 先读这里 · 本模式设置与使用方法
widgets_values:
# 01 · 单人全身替换

上传原视频和一张清晰全身参考图。默认替换最大的人物，包含脸、头发、服装与鞋子。时长 0＝整段，当前最多约 149 秒。先检查绿色遮罩覆盖全身和原衣物；补检保持开启。

本工作流沿用作者单人基线，模型、采样与原声共用现有部署。

---

## 作者单人基线参考（本模式以上方设置为准）

# Character Swap V1.5 · H3 Relay 2.0

1. Upload a source video and a character image or sheet in **User inputs**.
2. **Prepare Source** sets 24 fps and a canvas aligned to 32 pixels. Choose 480 or 768; duration 0 keeps the entire clip.
3. In **SAM person description**, identify the person to replace. Inspect the expanded mask preview.
4. In **H3 prompt**, describe the replacement and the performance to preserve. `<Picture 1>` is the character; `<Video 1>` is the source performance.
5. Run and inspect every window boundary in the saved video.

**Defaults:** both LoRAs at 1.0; 8 steps, `er_sde` / `normal`, CFG 1. This canvas has no separate scene anchor.

Final delivery uses the original source soundtrack. Start with one short continuous shot.

nodes.title: Note: Size Settings Reference
widgets_values:
# MiniMax H3 · Size Settings Reference

**24 fps · width and height divisible by 32.** Match the source aspect ratio. More pixels, longer windows and larger reference images require more memory.

| Approx. MP | Landscape reference |
|---|---|
| 0.21 | 608 × 352 |
| 0.31 | 736 × 416 |
| 0.41 | 864 × 480 |
| 0.52 | 960 × 544 |
| 0.64 | 1056 × 608 |
| 0.74 | 1152 × 640 |
| 0.82 | 1216 × 672 |
| 0.94 | 1280 × 736 |
| 1.03 | 1344 × 768 |

These are manually chosen reference sizes. **1344 × 768 exceeds a strict 1 MP cap.**

**Prepare Source uses strict pixel caps**, not a fixed output height. For an ideal 16:9 input, 480 (≤0.5 MP) gives **928 × 512**; 768 (≤1 MP) gives **1344 × 736**. Portrait inputs swap those dimensions; square inputs give 704 × 704 or 992 × 992. Already aligned sources within the cap keep their size. The node outputs the actual width and height.

nodes.title: Note: Windows, History & Review
widgets_values:
# Windows, history & review

H3 window sizes follow **17n + 5**: 22, 39, 56, 73, 90, 107, 124…

| Window | Duration at 24 fps |
|---|---|
| 22 frames | 0.92 s |
| 39 frames | 1.63 s |
| 107 frames | 4.46 s |
| 124 frames | 5.17 s |

**History 18** carries generated context into the next window. Keep history smaller than the window. The planner owns source ranges and seeds; native loops execute them. Assembly trims repeated overlap and padding back to the source frame count.

Keep the loop connections intact. The groups separate inputs, models, masks, planning, conditioning, sampling and output; they do not change execution.

**Masking:** SAM selects and tracks the source person; Relay recovery/expansion prepares the edit mask. The final video is raw decoded generation, without pasting the subject through a mask. Inspect identity, hands, hair, occlusions and continuation seams.

The app adds reviewed anchors and independent segment rerenders on top of this same toolkit.

**Memory:** Text Stage Memory and Sampling Workspace manage stage transitions. They respect explicit high-VRAM mode. Normal offloading was required for the unchanged fixture on 24 GB cards; this is not a blanket memory-fit guarantee.
